notifications.title: Pace test started, but one Short a day is slow to judge
notifications.detail: Your 19 Nov note ('increase the pace a little bit') started this channel's weekly cycle 1 (faster-voice): half the Shorts speak about 9% faster (~164 words a minute instead of ~151). The loop needs 8 Shorts a side; at 1 Short a day that is about 16 days, past the 14-day limit, so the test may end without a verdict.
notifications.fix: 1. To make every Short faster now, set voiceSpeed.short to 1.0 in channels/how-tech-and-ai-actually-work-chips-ai-p/channel.json (owner-only file), and tell the improver in a note to close the test; or 2. raise this channel to 2 Shorts a day on the Channels page so the test can finish; or 3. do nothing and the test runs to its limit.
